REQUEST
Create a character-design prompt for an adult lighthouse keeper. Give her weathered olive skin, tightly curled gray hair, a navy cable-knit sweater, orange waterproof bib trousers, black rubber boots, and a brass whistle on a cord. Describe character design only. Return one prompt with no scene, pose, expression, action, camera, lighting, weather, or story.

OUTPUT A
An adult female lighthouse keeper with weathered olive skin and tightly curled gray hair. She wears a navy cable-knit sweater beneath orange waterproof bib trousers, black rubber boots, and a brass whistle on a cord around her neck.

OUTPUT B
An adult female lighthouse keeper with weathered olive skin, fine facial lines, and tightly curled gray hair. Her clothing consists of a navy cable-knit sweater with thick braided texture, orange waterproof bib trousers with broad shoulder straps and reinforced seams, black rubber boots with sturdy soles, and a brass whistle on a simple cord around her neck.

CRITERION C04-SCOPE (hard)
The prompt remains strictly within character appearance, clothing, and equipment, without scene or presentation expansion.

REVIEW 29/48 — pair-c51c5c91ec0e

REQUEST
Inspect the supplied source image and write one image-to-video prompt that starts from it. Preserve its simple synthetic subject shapes, colors, initial composition, and flat graphic style. Animate only subtle water ripples and a slow cloud drift, with a very gentle camera push-in. Apart from these authorized temporal changes, do not add, remove, recolor, or reposition objects. Return only the prompt, with no label, notes, variants, or generation.

FIXTURE
[
  {
    "availability": "available binary fixture; inspect the repository path",
    "bytes": 522,
    "path": "case15-geometric-source.png",
    "sha256": "96d3453296fdd1239b21aeda140412632b643d96cb3980986739da4470bd8ded",
    "text": null
  }
]

OUTPUT A
Start from the supplied image, preserving its initial composition: a geometric red-hulled sailboat with a dark mast, white left sail and yellow right sail, blue water, pale blue sky, and one white cloud at upper right. Keep the simple shapes, original colors, and flat graphic style unchanged. Animate only subtle rippling of the existing water marks and a slow drift of the cloud, with a very gentle camera push-in. Keep the boat and sails motionless. Apart from these authorized changes, do not add, remove, recolor, reshape, or reposition anything.

OUTPUT B
Start from the supplied image, preserving the red boat, white and yellow triangular sails, dark mast, pale blue sky, white cloud, blue water, and light ripple marks in their exact initial composition and flat geometric style. Gently animate only the existing water ripples and a slow cloud drift, with a very gentle, smooth camera push-in. Keep the boat and sails still, all shapes and colors unchanged, and lighting constant; do not add, remove, or reposition anything except through the specified motion.

CRITERION C15-ROUTE (hard)
The response is an image-to-video prompt grounded in the supplied image as the first frame, not a text-to-video scene re-creation.
